title: ErasureBatchApplied
description:
`erasure_batch_applied` — the drain's summary of one batch over one member table, and the
reaper's record of a `batch_fatal` item. NOT an authority: each erased item's authority is its
own event, named by `authority_event`. Projected as the refusals it records.

ErasureBatchEntry.description:
One item's outcome in an [`ErasureBatchApplied`] record. The outcome is the item's, written to
every open row of it, in every erasure `erasures` names.

authority_event.description: The item's authorising event, when it was erased.

erasures.description: The erasures whose open rows of the item the batch locked.

member.description: The item's id, in the batch's member table.

reason.description: Why the item was set aside, when it was refused.

routine.description: The routine that raised the refusal: a function name, never a message.

sqlstate.description: The SQLSTATE of the error that refused the item.

ErasureBatchOutcome.description: What a batch did with one item, in an [`ErasureBatchEntry`].

oneOf.description: The item was erased, under its own authority event.
The item was set aside with a reason.

ErasureMemberRefusalReason.description:
The drain's closed refusal vocabulary: why an erasure member was set aside rather than erased.
Mirrored by the `kb_erasure_refusal_reasons` table, `policy/erasure/estate.toml`'s
`[refusal_reasons]` and the `erasure_refusal_reasons` seeds in `system.yaml`; a test holds the
four copies equal. Distinct from [`RecordedRefusalReason`], which is the single-resource doors'
ledger vocabulary.

oneOf.description: The item is a cogmap's telos or charter resource, which only map-grain erasure erases.
A verifier raised on the item, so only a code or data fix lets it finish.
The item failed its batch alone until the reaper set it aside.
The item's unit raised an error that no other code names.

ErasureMemberTable.description:
A table whose rows an erasure member can name. Serializes as the DDL spells the table.
Ordered by declaration, so it can key a map that serializes with stable bytes.
